anomalies.description: A red car collides with a silver sedan at an intersection; the red car's front end is severely damaged and parts are detached on the road, while the silver sedan skids sideways post-impact.

A white sedan collides with the rear right side of a stationary or slow-moving semi-trailer truck at an intersection, causing visible deformation to the front passenger side of the sedan and ejecting debris.; A white sedan (appearing to be a taxi) collides with the rear right side of a stationary or slow-moving semi-trailer truck at an intersection, resulting in visible damage to the front of the sedan and the truck's rear undercarriage; debris is scattered on the road.; A white-and-green sedan has collided with a large semi-trailer truck; the front of the sedan is severely damaged and crumpled, and debris (including what appears to be a motorcycle or scooter) lies on the road between the vehicles. A man approaches the scene and checks on the occupants.

A man approaches the crashed white sedan and appears to physically assault or drag a person lying on the ground near the driver's side door; the victim is motionless and in a vulnerable position, consistent with being helpless after the crash.

A black SUV on the left side of the road collides with a white van or minibus, causing visible deformation and abrupt lateral movement of the black SUV; the impact occurs while both vehicles are moving slowly in traffic under the overpass.; A yellow dump truck on the left lane collides with a black sedan directly ahead of it, causing the sedan to be pushed sideways and generating smoke/debris; the impact is visible from frame f7 through f14.

A large dump truck enters the intersection from the right and collides with a dark sedan that is turning left across its path. The impact occurs around frame f5–f7, with visible deformation and abrupt stop of the sedan.; A dump truck is seen colliding with or being struck by a dark sedan at an intersection; the truck's cab is visibly deformed and tilted, and debris is present near the impact zone.
A white dump truck entering the intersection from the right collides with a black sedan turning left, resulting in visible vehicle contact and displacement.

A dark-colored vehicle on the right side of the road (in the adjacent lane) is struck or collides, producing a visible puff of smoke/dust at impact; the white SUV ahead appears to swerve slightly in response.

A white-and-green sedan has collided with a large semi-trailer truck; the front of the sedan is severely damaged and crumpled, and debris (including what appears to be a motorcycle or scooter) lies on the road between the vehicles. A man approaches the scene and checks on the occupants.

A black SUV on the left side of the road collides with a white van or minibus, causing visible deformation and abrupt lateral movement of the black SUV; the impact occurs while both vehicles are moving slowly in traffic under the overpass.

A yellow dump truck on the left lane collides with a black sedan directly ahead of it, causing the sedan to be pushed sideways and generating smoke/debris; the impact is visible from frame f7 through f14.
A yellow dump truck on the left collides with a black sedan in front of it, causing visible deformation and smoke/dust; the impact occurs while both vehicles are moving slowly in traffic.
A white dump truck entering the intersection from the right collides with a black sedan turning left, resulting in visible vehicle contact and displacement.

A large dump truck enters the intersection from the right and collides with a dark sedan that is turning left across its path. The impact occurs around frame f5–f7, with visible deformation and abrupt stop of the sedan.
A dump truck is seen colliding with or being struck by a dark sedan at an intersection; the truck's cab is visibly deformed and tilted, and debris is present near the impact zone.

A dark-colored vehicle on the right side of the road (in the adjacent lane) is struck or collides, producing a visible puff of smoke/dust at impact; the white SUV ahead appears to swerve slightly in response.
